glass_priya: Pattern: I incorrectly assumed a strict swap between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1, or a default to counter_k1. Reality: The item is highly mobile. On day 30, it was at kitchen_table_k1 (19:36), then coffee_table_l1 (20:42), and finally nightstand_b1 (22:34). Next time: Do not assume a two-spot swap. Check nightstand_b1, kitchen_table_k1, and coffee_table_l1 with equal weight. If last seen in the living room, it may move to the bedroom or kitchen.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I guessed coffee_table_l1 twice on day 30 (19:36 and 20:07). Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1 both times. Next time: The item has been consistently at kitchen_table_k1 recently. Prioritize kitchen_table_k1 over coffee_table_l1 unless there is very recent evidence of a move to the living room.

razor_priya: Pattern: I guessed bathroom_shelf_ba1 on day 29. Reality: It was at sink_ba_ba1. This is the third consecutive day (days 27, 28, 29) where I guessed the shelf and it was at the sink. Next time: The item is firmly in a "sink" phase. Do not default to the shelf. Check sink_ba_ba1 first. Only switch to shelf if there is very recent evidence of a move.

mug_priya: Pattern: No errors today. Next time: Continue to strictly swap between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Do not guess other spots.

General Note: Avoid rigid location rules for glass_priya and water_bottle_priya. These items move frequently. For glass_priya, valid spots are counter_k1, kitchen_table_k1, cupboard_k1, coffee_table_l1, and nightstand_b1. For water_bottle_priya, valid spots are strictly kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1, but currently favoring kitchen_table_k1. For razor_priya, valid spots are sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1, currently favoring sink_ba_ba1. Always prioritize recent specific evidence.
